acquisition_method: The instrument methods employed for LTQ Orbitrap Velos were set up in data-dependent acquisition (DDA) mode.
alkylation_concentration: the alkylation of free cysteine residues was achieved by adding iodoacetamide-IAA (Sigma-Aldrich) to a final concentration of 14 mM for 30 min at room temperature in the dark.
alkylation_reagent: the alkylation of free cysteine residues was achieved by adding iodoacetamide-IAA (Sigma-Aldrich) to a final concentration of 14 mM
cleavage_agent: Samples were digested with sequencing-grade porcine trypsin (Promega) at an enzyme/substrate ratio of 1:100
collision_energy: fragmented in the high-pressure linear ion trap by collision-induced dissociation (CID) with a normalized collision energy of 35%.
fragmentation_method: fragmented in the high-pressure linear ion trap by collision-induced dissociation (CID)
instrument: Peptide digests (2 μg) from LiP-MS and tryptic digestion-only proteome samples were analyzed on an LTQ Orbitrap Velos (Thermo Fisher Scientific, San Jose, CA) mass spectrometer
ionization_type: coupled to nanoflow liquid chromatography on an EASYnLC system (Proxeon Biosystems, Odense, DK) with a Proxeon nanoelectrospray ion source.
labeling: inferred: LFQ values transformed in Log2 were used for quantification.
mass_analyzer: Resolution in the Orbitrap was set to r = 60,000
ptm: Cysteine carbamidomethylation (+57.0214 Da) and methionine oxidation (+15.99492) were allowed as fixed and variable modifications, respectively
reduction_concentration: The saliva samples analyzed in this study were reduced by incubation with dithiothreitol (DTT) (Sigma-Aldrich) to a final concentration of 5 mM for 25 min at 56 °C.
reduction_reagent: The saliva samples analyzed in this study were reduced by incubation with dithiothreitol (DTT) (Sigma-Aldrich)
